```{r karte}
# Daten laden
standorte <- readxl::read_excel("../../R/Arvato_Distributionsstandorte_Deutschland.xlsx")

# Automobilwerke in Norddeutschland und Benelux (Kunden / Bedarfsorte)
# Bekannte Werke in der Region: VW Wolfsburg, BMW Hannover,
# Mercedes Bremen, Daimler Düsseldorf, Volvo Gent, Audi Brüssel,
# VW Emden, Ford Köln, Opel Rüsselsheim
kunden <- data.frame(
  name = c(
    "VW Wolfsburg", "VW Emden", "BMW Hannover",
    "Mercedes Bremen", "Daimler Düsseldorf", "Ford Köln",

)

# Mögliche Lagerstandorte aus Arvato-Daten
# (Repräsentative Standorte aus Norddeutschland + Benelux)
if (exists("standorte") && "lat" %in% names(standorte) && "lon" %in% names(standorte)) {
```

## Problemstellung
Zur Versorgung der Automobilwerke in Norddeutschland und den Benelux-Ländern mit Antriebs-Batterien soll eine Versorgungskette aufgebaut werden. Ein bereits in der Automobilbranche tätiger Logistikdienstleister bietet an, die Versorgung der Werke mit Antriebs-Batterien zu übernehmen. Dazu müssen Investitionen in die Lagerstandorte getätigt werden, um die Regularien für Gefahrgutlagerung einzuhalten.

## Fallstudie - Batterielogistik
::: slide-subtitle
Aufgabe
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Zielformulierung

Sie wurden von ihrem Vorgesetzten aufgefordert eine Entscheidungsvorlage für erarbeiten, wie die Batteriedistribution organisiert werden könnte. Die Vorlage soll eine Zuordnung der Werke zu Versorgungslagern enthalten. Auf Basis dieser Zuordnung erwartet das Management eine Abschätzung der jährlichen Gesamtkosten, die aus Ihrem Vorschlag resultieren würden. Dies soll als Grundlage für ein Angebot und die Verhandlungen mit dem Automobilkonsortium dienen.
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-up}
### Aufgaben

1. Formulieren Sie einen Ansatz zur Berechnung der jährlichen Gesamtkosten. 
2. Formulieren Sie einen Ansatz zur Berechnung der Transportkosten für die Batteriedistribution per LKW.
3. Ermitteln Sie dazu einen geeigneten Transportkostensatz für Batterien. 
4. Finden Sie eine Zuordnung der Werke zu den Lagerstandorten ermitteln Sie die Gesamtkosten Ihrer Lösung.
:::

## Warehouse Location Problem {#slide-wlp-1}
::: slide-subtitle
Problembeschreibung
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon=false}
**Problemstellung**

Gegeben sei eine Menge an **Kundenstandorten** und eine Menge (potentieller) **Lagerhausstandorte**. Jeder Kundenstandort hat eine **Warennachfrage** (z.B. in Stück pro Monat/Jahr), die von den Lagerhäusern beliefert warden muss. Der Transport der Waren verursacht entfernungsabhängige **Transportkosten**. Die Eröffnung eines Lagerhauses verursacht **Einrichtungskosten**.

Es ist zu entscheiden, an welchen Standorten Lagerhäuser eingerichtet werden sollen und welche Kunden diese versorgen sollen.
:::

::: columns
::: {.column width="55%"}

::: {.smaller-text}
::: {.fragment .fade-up}
**Notation**

- Menge der Lagerhäuser $i \in I$
- Menge der Kundenstandorte $j \in J$
- Transportverbindungen $E \subseteq I \times J$
- Eröffnungskosten an Lagerstandort $i$: $f_i$
- Transportkosten (z.B. in €/Monat) Standort $i$ zu Kunde $j$: $c_{ij}$
- Nachfrage von Kunde $j$: $a_j$
:::
:::
:::

::: {.column width="42%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-up}

```{r wlp-graph}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-height: 5

# --- Koordinaten (normiert 0..1) ---
lager <- data.frame(
  id  = c("W1","W2","W3"),
  lbl = c("1","2","3"),
  fi  = c("f<sub>1</sub>", "...", "f<sub>3</sub>"),
  x   = 0.20,
  y   = c(0.15, 0.50, 0.85)
)

kunden <- data.frame(
  id  = c("A","B","C","D"),
  lbl = c("A","B","C","D"),
  aj  = c("a<sub>A</sub>", "", "...", "a<sub>D</sub>"),
  x   = 0.75,
  y   = c(0.85, 0.60, 0.35, 0.10)
)

lxy <- setNames(lager[, c("x","y")],   c("x","y")); rownames(lxy) <- lager$id
kxy <- setNames(kunden[, c("x","y")],  c("x","y")); rownames(kxy) <- kunden$id

# Knotenradius in Plot-Koordinaten (angepasst an fig-Größe)
r <- 0.058   # <-- ggf. leicht anpassen wenn Größe ändert

edges <- data.frame(
  from = c("W3","W3","W2","W2","W2","W1"),
  to   = c("A", "B", "B", "C", "D", "D"),
  lbl  = c("c<sub>1A</sub>","","","","","c<sub>3D</sub>"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

fig <- plot_ly(type = "scatter", mode = "markers")

# Kanten: Endpunkte auf Rand der Knoten verschieben
for (i in seq_len(nrow(edges))) {
  x0 <- lxy[edges$from[i], "x"];  y0 <- lxy[edges$from[i], "y"]
  x1 <- kxy[edges$to[i],   "x"];  y1 <- kxy[edges$to[i],   "y"]

  dx <- x1 - x0;  dy <- y1 - y0
  d  <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)

  # Startpunkt: r vom Lager-Mittelpunkt entfernt Richtung Kunde
  ax <- x0 + r * dx / d
  ay <- y0 + r * dy / d
  # Endpunkt:   r vom Kunden-Mittelpunkt entfernt Richtung Lager
  ex <- x1 - r * dx / d
  ey <- y1 - r * dy / d

  fig <- fig %>% add_annotations(
    x = ex, y = ey, ax = ax, ay = ay,
    xref = "x", yref = "y", axref = "x", ayref = "y",
    showarrow = TRUE, arrowhead = 2, arrowsize = 1,
    arrowwidth = 1.5, arrowcolor = "#4B4B4B", text = ""
  )

  # Kanten-Label mittig
  if (nchar(edges$lbl[i]) > 0) {
    fig <- fig %>% add_annotations(
      x = (ax + ex) / 2 + 0.02, y = (ay + ey) / 2 + 0.025,
      xref = "x", yref = "y",
      text = edges$lbl[i], showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(size = 13, color = "#1F2933", family = "Arial")
    )
  }
}

# Lager-Knoten (Hexagon)
fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
  x = lager$x, y = lager$y, text = lager$lbl,
  mode = "markers+text",
  marker = list(symbol = "hexagon", size = 40,
                color = "#BFDBF7", line = list(color = "#4B5563", width = 1.5)),
  textfont = list(size = 16, color = "#1F2933", family = "Arial"),
  textposition = "middle center",
  hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE
)

# f_i links
fig <- fig %>% add_annotations(
  x = lager$x - 0.10, y = lager$y,
  xref = "x", yref = "y",
  text = lager$fi, showarrow = FALSE,
  font = list(size = 14, color = "#1F2933", family = "Arial"),
  xanchor = "right"
)

# Kunden-Knoten (Circle)
fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
  x = kunden$x, y = kunden$y, text = kunden$lbl,
  mode = "markers+text",
  marker = list(symbol = "circle", size = 40,
                color = "#2D9E8E", line = list(color = "#2F3E46", width = 1.5)),
  textfont = list(size = 16, color = "white", family = "Arial"),
  textposition = "middle center",
  hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE
)

# a_j rechts
fig <- fig %>% add_annotations(
  x = kunden$x + 0.08, y = kunden$y,
  xref = "x", yref = "y",
  text = kunden$aj, showarrow = FALSE,
  font = list(size = 14, color = "#1F2933", family = "Arial"),
  xanchor = "left"
)

# Set-Labels
fig <- fig %>% add_annotations(
  x = c(0.20, 0.75), y = c(1.00, 1.00),
  xref = "x", yref = "y",
  text = c("<b>Set <i>I</i></b>", "<b>Set <i>J</i></b>"),
  showarrow = FALSE,
  font = list(size = 14, color = "#1F2933", family = "Arial")
)

fig <- fig %>% layout(
  xaxis = list(visible = FALSE, range = c(0, 1), fixedrange = TRUE),
  yaxis = list(visible = FALSE, range = c(-0.05, 1.08), fixedrange = TRUE),
  plot_bgcolor  = "transparent",
  paper_bgcolor = "transparent",
  margin = list(l = 40, r = 40, t = 10, b = 10),
  height = 380
)

fig
```

## Warehouse Location Problem {#slide-wlp-model}
::: slide-subtitle
Mathematisches Modell
:::

::: columns
::: {.column width="55%"}

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple" icon=false}
#### Gemischt-ganzzahliges lineares Optimierungsmodell
Minimiere die Gesamtkosten aus Transport und Standorteröffnung

$$\min \rightarrow \sum_{i \in I} y_i \cdot f_i + \sum_{(i,j) \in E} x_{ij} \cdot c_{ij}$$
:::

::: {.smaller-text}

**Nebenbedingungen**
$$
\begin{align}
  \sum_{(i,j) \in E} x_{ij} &= a_j          & \forall j \in J      &\quad\rightarrow \text{Nachfrage befriedigen} \\
  x_{ij}                    &\leq y_i \cdot a_j & \forall (i,j) \in E &\quad\rightarrow \text{nur Transporte von eröffneten Standorten} \\
  x_{ij}                    &\geq 0          & \forall (i,j) \in E &\quad\rightarrow \text{Transportmengen nicht negativ} \\
  y_i                       &\in \{0,1\}     & \forall i \in I     &\quad\rightarrow \text{Standort wird eröffnet oder nicht}
\end{align}
$$
:::

:::
::: {.column width="43%"}

```{r wlp-graph2}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| out-width: "99%"
#| fig-height: 5

# --- Koordinaten (normiert 0..1) ---
lager <- data.frame(
  id  = c("W1","W2","W3"),
  lbl = c("1","2","3"),
  fi  = c("f<sub>1</sub>", "...", "f<sub>3</sub>"),
  x   = 0.20,
  y   = c(0.15, 0.50, 0.85)
)

kunden <- data.frame(
  id  = c("A","B","C","D"),
  lbl = c("A","B","C","D"),
  aj  = c("a<sub>A</sub>", "", "...", "a<sub>D</sub>"),
  x   = 0.75,
  y   = c(0.85, 0.60, 0.35, 0.10)
)

lxy <- setNames(lager[, c("x","y")],   c("x","y")); rownames(lxy) <- lager$id
kxy <- setNames(kunden[, c("x","y")],  c("x","y")); rownames(kxy) <- kunden$id

# Knotenradius in Plot-Koordinaten (angepasst an fig-Größe)
r <- 0.058   # <-- ggf. leicht anpassen wenn Größe ändert

edges <- data.frame(
  from = c("W3","W3","W2","W2","W2","W1"),
  to   = c("A", "B", "B", "C", "D", "D"),
  lbl  = c("c<sub>1A</sub>","","","","","c<sub>3D</sub>"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

fig <- plot_ly(type = "scatter", mode = "markers")

# Kanten: Endpunkte auf Rand der Knoten verschieben
for (i in seq_len(nrow(edges))) {
  x0 <- lxy[edges$from[i], "x"];  y0 <- lxy[edges$from[i], "y"]
  x1 <- kxy[edges$to[i],   "x"];  y1 <- kxy[edges$to[i],   "y"]

  dx <- x1 - x0;  dy <- y1 - y0
  d  <- sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)

  # Startpunkt: r vom Lager-Mittelpunkt entfernt Richtung Kunde
  ax <- x0 + r * dx / d
  ay <- y0 + r * dy / d
  # Endpunkt:   r vom Kunden-Mittelpunkt entfernt Richtung Lager
  ex <- x1 - r * dx / d
  ey <- y1 - r * dy / d

  fig <- fig %>% add_annotations(
    x = ex, y = ey, ax = ax, ay = ay,
    xref = "x", yref = "y", axref = "x", ayref = "y",
    showarrow = TRUE, arrowhead = 2, arrowsize = 1,
    arrowwidth = 1.5, arrowcolor = "#4B4B4B", text = ""
  )

  # Kanten-Label mittig
  if (nchar(edges$lbl[i]) > 0) {
    fig <- fig %>% add_annotations(
      x = (ax + ex) / 2 + 0.02, y = (ay + ey) / 2 + 0.025,
      xref = "x", yref = "y",
      text = edges$lbl[i], showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(size = 13, color = "#1F2933", family = "Arial")
    )
  }
}

# Lager-Knoten (Hexagon)
fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
  x = lager$x, y = lager$y, text = lager$lbl,
  mode = "markers+text",
  marker = list(symbol = "hexagon", size = 40,
                color = "#BFDBF7", line = list(color = "#4B5563", width = 1.5)),
  textfont = list(size = 16, color = "#1F2933", family = "Arial"),
  textposition = "middle center",
  hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE
)

# f_i links
fig <- fig %>% add_annotations(
  x = lager$x - 0.10, y = lager$y,
  xref = "x", yref = "y",
  text = lager$fi, showarrow = FALSE,
  font = list(size = 14, color = "#1F2933", family = "Arial"),
  xanchor = "right"
)

# Kunden-Knoten (Circle)
fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
  x = kunden$x, y = kunden$y, text = kunden$lbl,
  mode = "markers+text",
  marker = list(symbol = "circle", size = 40,
                color = "#2D9E8E", line = list(color = "#2F3E46", width = 1.5)),
  textfont = list(size = 16, color = "white", family = "Arial"),
  textposition = "middle center",
  hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE
)

# a_j rechts
fig <- fig %>% add_annotations(
  x = kunden$x + 0.08, y = kunden$y,
  xref = "x", yref = "y",
  text = kunden$aj, showarrow = FALSE,
  font = list(size = 14, color = "#1F2933", family = "Arial"),
  xanchor = "left"
)

# Set-Labels
fig <- fig %>% add_annotations(
  x = c(0.20, 0.75), y = c(1.00, 1.00),
  xref = "x", yref = "y",
  text = c("<b>Set <i>I</i></b>", "<b>Set <i>J</i></b>"),
  showarrow = FALSE,
  font = list(size = 14, color = "#1F2933", family = "Arial")
)

fig <- fig %>% layout(
  xaxis = list(visible = FALSE, range = c(0, 1), fixedrange = TRUE),
  yaxis = list(visible = FALSE, range = c(-0.05, 1.08), fixedrange = TRUE),
  plot_bgcolor  = "transparent",
  paper_bgcolor = "transparent",
  margin = list(l = 40, r = 40, t = 10, b = 10),
  height = 380
)

fig
```

## WLP – Kleines Fallbeispiel {#slide-wlp-example}
::: slide-subtitle
Probleminstanz (5 Lager, 6 Kunden)
:::

```{r wlp-example-data}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Problemdaten
wlp_lager <- data.frame(
  ID      = c("W1", "W2", "W3", "W4", "W5"),
  fi      = c(110,  95, 140,  80, 125),   # Eröffnungskosten (T€/Jahr)
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

wlp_kunden <- data.frame(
  ID  = c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6"),
  aj  = c(40,   25,   60,   30,   50,   35),   # Nachfrage (Einheiten)
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Transportkosten cij (T€ je Einheit × km, bereits als Gesamtkosten pro Jahr)
wlp_cij <- matrix(
  c(1.8, 3.2, 2.5, 4.1, 1.2, 3.7,
    3.4, 1.1, 3.8, 1.6, 2.9, 2.2,
    2.6, 4.0, 1.3, 3.5, 3.1, 1.9,
    4.2, 1.8, 2.9, 1.0, 3.6, 2.7,
    1.5, 3.6, 3.3, 4.4, 2.0, 1.4),
  nrow = 5, byrow = TRUE,
  dimnames = list(wlp_lager$ID, wlp_kunden$ID)
)
```

::: columns
::: {.column width="38%"}

::: small-text
**Lager – Eröffnungskosten $f_i$ (T€/Jahr)**

```{r}
#| echo: false
kbl(wlp_lager,
    col.names = c("Lager $i$", "$f_i$ (T€)"),
    align = c("c","r"), escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed","striped"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 18) |>
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#2F3E46", color = "white") |>
  row_spec(0, background = "#2F3E46", color = "white", bold = TRUE)
```

**Kunden – Nachfrage $a_j$ (Einheiten/Jahr)**

```{r}
#| echo: false
kbl(wlp_kunden,
    col.names = c("Kunde $j$", "$a_j$"),
    align = c("c","r"), escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed","striped"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 18) |>
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#2D9E8E", color = "white") |>
  row_spec(0, background = "#2D9E8E", color = "white", bold = TRUE)
```
:::

:::
::: {.column width="59%"}

::: small-text
**Transportkosten $c_{ij}$ (T€/Einheit · Jahr)**

```{r}
#| echo: false
kbl(as.data.frame(wlp_cij),
    align = rep("r", 6), escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed","striped"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 18) |>
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#2F3E46", color = "white") |>
  row_spec(0, background = "#2F3E46", color = "white", bold = TRUE)
```

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
**Gesamtkosten** = Eröffnungskosten der gewählten Lager  
$\quad\quad\quad\quad\quad\quad$ + Transportkosten × Nachfrage je Zuordnung  
$$Z = \sum_{i} y_i f_i + \sum_{i,j} x_{ij} \cdot c_{ij}$$
:::
:::

## WLP – Lösung mit R/OMPR {#slide-wlp-ompr}
::: slide-subtitle
Implementierung als MILP
:::

::: columns
::: {.column width="55%"}

```{r wlp-ompr-code}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| code-line-numbers: true

library(ompr)
library(ompr.roi)
library(ROI.plugin.glpk)

# Problemdaten
n_I <- 5; n_J <- 6
f   <- c(110, 95, 140, 80, 125)
a   <- c(40, 25, 60, 30, 50, 35)
c_ij <- matrix(
  c(1.8,3.2,2.5,4.1,1.2,3.7,
    3.4,1.1,3.8,1.6,2.9,2.2,
    2.6,4.0,1.3,3.5,3.1,1.9,
    4.2,1.8,2.9,1.0,3.6,2.7,
    1.5,3.6,3.3,4.4,2.0,1.4),
  nrow = n_I, byrow = TRUE)

# MILP-Modell
model <- MIPModel() |>
  # Variablen
  add_variable(y[i], i = 1:n_I, type = "binary") |>
  add_variable(x[i,j], i = 1:n_I, j = 1:n_J,
               type = "continuous", lb = 0) |>
  # Zielfunktion
  set_objective(
    sum_expr(f[i] * y[i], i = 1:n_I) +
    sum_expr(c_ij[i,j] * x[i,j],
             i = 1:n_I, j = 1:n_J),
    sense = "min") |>
  # NB1: Nachfrage vollständig befriedigen
  add_constraint(
    sum_expr(x[i,j], i = 1:n_I) == a[j],
    j = 1:n_J) |>
  # NB2: Transport nur von eröffneten Lagern
  add_constraint(
    x[i,j] <= y[i] * a[j],
    i = 1:n_I, j = 1:n_J)

result <- solve_model(model,
           with_ROI(solver = "glpk", verbose = FALSE))
```

:::
::: {.column width="42%"}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## OMPR – Workflow

1. `MIPModel()` → leeres Modell
2. `add_variable()` → Entscheidungsvariablen
3. `set_objective()` → Zielfunktion
4. `add_constraint()` → Nebenbedingungen
5. `solve_model()` → Solver aufrufen
6. `get_solution()` → Lösung extrahieren
:::

```{r wlp-ompr-result}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Optimale Lösung extrahieren
y_sol <- get_solution(result, y[i])
x_sol <- get_solution(result, x[i,j])

# Geöffnete Lager
offene_lager <- y_sol$i[y_sol$value > 0.5]

# Optimaler Zielfunktionswert
obj_val <- objective_value(result)
```

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
**Optimaler Zielfunktionswert:**  
```{r}
#| echo: false
cat(paste0("Z* = ", round(obj_val, 1), " T€/Jahr"))
```
**Geöffnete Lager:** W`r paste(offene_lager, collapse = ", W")`
:::

:::
:::

## WLP – Optimale Lösung {#slide-wlp-solution}
::: slide-subtitle
Ergebnis und Zuordnung
:::

::: columns
::: {.column width="48%"}

```{r wlp-solution-table}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Zuordnungstabelle aufbereiten
zuordnung <- x_sol |>
  dplyr::filter(value > 0.001) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Lager  = paste0("W", i),
    Kunde  = paste0("C", j),
    Menge  = value,
    Kosten = round(c_ij[cbind(i, j)] * value, 1)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Lager, Kunde, Menge, Kosten)

kbl(zuordnung,
    col.names = c("Lager $i$","Kunde $j$",
                  "Menge $x_{ij}$","Transportkosten (T€)"),
    align = c("c","c","r","r"), escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed","striped"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 17) |>
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#2F3E46", color = "white") |>
  column_spec(2, bold = TRUE, background = "#2D9E8E", color = "white") |>
  row_spec(0, background = "#2F3E46", color = "white", bold = TRUE)
```

```{r wlp-cost-breakdown}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

eroeffnung  <- sum(f[offene_lager])
transport   <- sum(zuordnung$Kosten)

kosten_df <- data.frame(
  Kostenart = c("Eröffnungskosten", "Transportkosten", "Gesamtkosten Z*"),
  Wert      = c(eroeffnung, transport, round(obj_val, 1))
)

kbl(kosten_df,
    col.names = c("Kostenart", "T€/Jahr"),
    align = c("l","r")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 17) |>
  row_spec(3, bold = TRUE, background = "#2F3E46", color = "white") |>
  row_spec(0, background = "#2F3E46", color = "white", bold = TRUE)
```

:::
::: {.column width="50%"}

```{r wlp-solution-plot}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| out-width: "99%"
#| fig-height: 5.5

lager_pos <- data.frame(
  id = paste0("W", 1:5),
  x  = 0.18,
  y  = c(0.08, 0.30, 0.52, 0.74, 0.92),
  open = c(1 %in% offene_lager,
           2 %in% offene_lager,
           3 %in% offene_lager,
           4 %in% offene_lager,
           5 %in% offene_lager)
)

kunden_pos <- data.frame(
  id = paste0("C", 1:6),
  x  = 0.80,
  y  = c(0.92, 0.74, 0.56, 0.38, 0.20, 0.04)
)

lxy2 <- setNames(lager_pos[, c("x","y")], c("x","y"))
rownames(lxy2) <- lager_pos$id
kxy2 <- setNames(kunden_pos[, c("x","y")], c("x","y"))
rownames(kxy2) <- kunden_pos$id

r2 <- 0.048

fig2 <- plot_ly(type = "scatter", mode = "markers")

# Aktive Kanten
active_edges <- x_sol |> dplyr::filter(value > 0.001) |>
  dplyr::mutate(from = paste0("W", i), to = paste0("C", j))

# Alle möglichen Kanten (dünn, grau)
for (ii in 1:5) for (jj in 1:6) {
  wi <- paste0("W", ii); cj <- paste0("C", jj)
  x0 <- lxy2[wi,"x"]; y0 <- lxy2[wi,"y"]
  x1 <- kxy2[cj,"x"]; y1 <- kxy2[cj,"y"]
  dx <- x1-x0; dy <- y1-y0; dd <- sqrt(dx^2+dy^2)
  ax <- x0 + r2*dx/dd; ay <- y0 + r2*dy/dd
  ex <- x1 - r2*dx/dd; ey <- y1 - r2*dy/dd
  fig2 <- fig2 %>% add_annotations(
    x=ex,y=ey,ax=ax,ay=ay,
    xref="x",yref="y",axref="x",ayref="y",
    showarrow=TRUE,arrowhead=0,arrowsize=0.8,
    arrowwidth=0.8,arrowcolor="#D0D5DD",text="")
}

# Aktive Kanten (fett, farbig)
for (k in seq_len(nrow(active_edges))) {
  wi <- active_edges$from[k]; cj <- active_edges$to[k]
  x0 <- lxy2[wi,"x"]; y0 <- lxy2[wi,"y"]
  x1 <- kxy2[cj,"x"]; y1 <- kxy2[cj,"y"]
  dx <- x1-x0; dy <- y1-y0; dd <- sqrt(dx^2+dy^2)
  ax <- x0 + r2*dx/dd; ay <- y0 + r2*dy/dd
  ex <- x1 - r2*dx/dd; ey <- y1 - r2*dy/dd
  fig2 <- fig2 %>% add_annotations(
    x=ex,y=ey,ax=ax,ay=ay,
    xref="x",yref="y",axref="x",ayref="y",
    showarrow=TRUE,arrowhead=2,arrowsize=1,
    arrowwidth=2.2,arrowcolor="#01696f",text="")
  mx <- (ax+ex)/2 + 0.025; my <- (ay+ey)/2 + 0.03
  fig2 <- fig2 %>% add_annotations(
    x=mx,y=my,xref="x",yref="y",
    text=paste0("x=",active_edges$value[k]),
    showarrow=FALSE,
    font=list(size=11,color="#01696f",family="Arial"))
}

# Lagerpunkte
lager_col <- ifelse(lager_pos$open, "#BFDBF7", "#E8E8E8")
lager_brd <- ifelse(lager_pos$open, "#4B5563", "#B0B0B0")
fig2 <- fig2 %>% add_trace(
  x=lager_pos$x, y=lager_pos$y, text=lager_pos$id,
  mode="markers+text",
  marker=list(symbol="hexagon",size=38,
              color=lager_col,
              line=list(color=lager_brd,width=2)),
  textfont=list(size=14,color="#1F2933",family="Arial"),
  textposition="middle center",
  hoverinfo="skip",showlegend=FALSE)

# Öffnungs-Label
fig2 <- fig2 %>% add_annotations(
  x=lager_pos$x - 0.09, y=lager_pos$y,
  xref="x",yref="y",
  text=ifelse(lager_pos$open,
              paste0("f=",f[1:5],"✓"),
              paste0("f=",f[1:5])),
  showarrow=FALSE,
  font=list(size=11,
            color=ifelse(lager_pos$open,"#01696f","#9CA3AF"),
            family="Arial"),
  xanchor="right")

# Kundenpunkte
fig2 <- fig2 %>% add_trace(
  x=kunden_pos$x, y=kunden_pos$y, text=kunden_pos$id,
  mode="markers+text",
  marker=list(symbol="circle",size=38,
              color="#2D9E8E",line=list(color="#2F3E46",width=1.5)),
  textfont=list(size=14,color="white",family="Arial"),
  textposition="middle center",
  hoverinfo="skip",showlegend=FALSE)

fig2 <- fig2 %>% add_annotations(
  x=kunden_pos$x+0.07, y=kunden_pos$y,
  xref="x",yref="y",
  text=paste0("a=",a),
  showarrow=FALSE,
  font=list(size=11,color="#1F2933",family="Arial"),
  xanchor="left")

fig2 <- fig2 %>% layout(
  xaxis=list(visible=FALSE,range=c(0,1),fixedrange=TRUE),
  yaxis=list(visible=FALSE,range=c(-0.05,1.05),fixedrange=TRUE),
  plot_bgcolor="transparent",
  paper_bgcolor="transparent",
  margin=list(l=40,r=20,t=10,b=10),
  height=420)

fig2
```
